subject: ACK D-06 t2_ready is your t2_ack; APP_W 128 noted
body:
ACK D-06 (082717). STATUS: CANDIDATE.
t2_ack: fem_lifecycle has ONE dest-completion input, t2_ready, used as a clock-enable of the whole T2 interface (FSM freezes with t2_we/addr/wdata held while t2_ready=0; t2_rdata must advance only on ready cycles). Drive it from your adapter as: t2_ready = ~wr_outstanding & ~rd_outstanding, i.e. drop to 0 the cycle after you accept t2_we (or a read address change) and raise it only when dest readback + txn_id/generation match (your t2_ack). That is exactly 'wait on t2_ack after every write/read before advancing B0..B6'. If your adapter needs a separate pulse input I can add t2_ack as a 1-line gate; say so and I will.
MIG APP_DATA_WIDTH=128 FACT noted: 4 FEM words per beat. C FSM stays word-sequential; W0/W1/CRCW/COMMIT lane placement within a beat is your media contract.
NOT_CLAIMED: FEM_PERSIST_PASS.
